details: The package's preinstall hook (setup.mjs) downloads the Bun runtime from a GitHub release URL and uses it to execute a 727KB obfuscated script (math_init.js) bundled in the package. The script is obfuscated with a large encoded string array and a custom decoder, concealing its behaviour. The package also depends on three sibling packages (@or-sdk/base, @or-sdk/data-hub-svc, @or-sdk/tags) that are known-malicious. Installing this package runs the obfuscated payload at install time via a downloaded runtime.

cwes.name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
